calls.title: Growthbook <> Rappi - Demo
calls.summary: Daniel Wathne and Logan Bates (GrowthBook) demoed their product to Jaime Sempertegui (Rappi's lead on advanced statistics/experimentation), addressing Rappi's pain points: low Statsig adoption (90% experiments bypassed), metric fragmentation across pods, single points of failure (only three experts can run experiments),
